name: pragmatic_dual_rating_7pt
summary: Two-step listener paradigm collecting 7-point likelihood ratings on two distinct probed objects within the same scene.

charter.question: How do listeners jointly grade the plausibility of two distinct candidate referents (such as competing true referents or false distractors) within the same referential context?

instructions.welcome: Welcome! You will see groups of cartoons (robots, houses, and snowmen) and judge which one a speaker means.
instructions.task: On each screen, a speaker sees the same objects you see and says one word for one object. You will rate two highlighted objects one after the other from 1 (Very unlikely) to 7 (Very likely): first rate how likely the speaker meant the first highlighted object, then rate the second highlighted object. Rate an object 1 if it lacks the named part, and 7 if it uniquely has that part.

comprehension_checks.question: What do you do on each screen?
options: Rate two highlighted objects from 1 (Very unlikely) to 7 (Very likely), one after the other
Type a word for each object

comprehension_checks.question: Does the speaker see the same objects on the screen that you see?
options: Yes, the speaker sees the exact same objects
No, the speaker sees different objects
